inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Six Inches if Equipment 5 Ft or Less: The operation's loose fill does not meet the required 6-inch depth in the use zone of the play equipment.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Six Inches if Equipment 5 Ft or Less (26 TAC §746.4907(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: The operation has six sinks for the children to use, but three of them are not working. Also, CCR observed that in the children's restroom, an outlet wall plate was misaligned with the outlet and light switch, leaving electrical components exposed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Not Used During Eating or Rest Times: CCR observed the children watching the cartoon 'Bluey' on television while eating breakfast.    Correction made: The caregiver turned off the television.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Not Used During Eating or Rest Times (26 TAC §746.2207(c)(4))

occurrences.finding: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Keep Separate from Food and Inaccessible to Children: CCR found that the child lock on the bottom cabinet in the infant classroom was broken, which made the cleaning supplies accessible to the children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Keep Separate from Food and Inaccessible to Children (26 TAC §746.3407(12))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2985): The Infant Caregiver Affidavit Form 2985 was not notarized.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2985) (26 TAC §746.901(4))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2912): The second page of the Infant Caregiver Affidavit Form 2912 was incomplete.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2912) (26 TAC §746.901(5))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Sanitation Inspection Report: During the inspection, the most recent sanitation inspection report was not available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Sanitation Inspection Report (26 TAC §746.801(12))

occurrences.finding: Medication Authorization Expires on First Anniversary: CCR found one expired ointment in the infant's room.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Medication Authorization Expires on First Anniversary (26 TAC §746.3803(b))

occurrences.finding: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device - Remove the infant from the device and place the infant in a crib as soon as possible: CCR observed a two-month-old infant sleeping in a restrictive device, specifically a "Baby Bouncer."  Correction made: The infant caregiver removed the infant from the Baby Bouncer and placed the infant in the crib.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device - Remove the infant from the device and place the infant in a crib as soon as possible (26 TAC §746.2426(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Liability Insurance Requirements -  Provide Proof of Coverage Annually by Anniversary Date of Issuance: The operation does not have current insurance; its coverage expired on 3/25/2026.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Liability Insurance Requirements -  Provide Proof of Coverage Annually by Anniversary Date of Issuance (26 TAC §746.203(2))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training Area - 24 Hours Required: An infant/transporter caregiver is missing all required training for the annual training year 9/23/2024-9/23/2025.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training Area - 24 Hours Required (26 TAC §746.1309(a))

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Not Used During Eating or Rest Times: During naptime, CCR observed school-age children watching television.     Correction made: A caregiver then turned off the television.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Not Used During Eating or Rest Times (26 TAC §746.2207(c)(4))

occurrences.finding: Posting Requirements - Letter or form from the most recent Licensing Inspection or Investigation: The operation does not have the most recent inspection report posted; the last inspection report posted is dated 10/28/2024.    Correction made: The operation replaces the old inspection report with the current inspection report.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Posting Requirements - Letter or form from the most recent Licensing Inspection or Investigation (26 TAC §746.401(2))

occurrences.finding: Director Annual Training 30 Hours Required: The director is missing all required training for the annual training year 4/21/2024-4/21/2025.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Annual Training 30 Hours Required (26 TAC §746.1311(a))

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: During the walk-through, I observed that the infant's room was out of ratio. There were 10 infants in the classroom and the specified age of the children is 11months, and there were only one caregiver present.    Correction: Another caregiver came into the classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Six Inches if Equipment 5 Ft or Less: The pre-school playground did not have the required six inch surfacing on the playground.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Six Inches if Equipment 5 Ft or Less (26 TAC §746.4907(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Fenced Outdoor Activity Space -Exits Required: The toddler playground did not have a second exit on the playground.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fenced Outdoor Activity Space -Exits Required (26 TAC §746.4307)

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: One child did not have immunizations in their file and the other child did not have the current records for a four year old child.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §746.603(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Snug Fitting Sheets: In the infant room, two children were asleep on bare mattress.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Snug Fitting Sheets (26 TAC §746.2409(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Humiliating, Rejecting, Yelling: Based on the preponderance of the evidence obtained during the investigation conducted by DFPS, a caregiver was yelling and screaming at children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Humiliating, Rejecting, Yelling (26 TAC §746.2805(5))

occurrences.finding: Hand Sanitizer - Not Used on Visibly Soiled Hands Unless Away From Classroom and Soap & Water Not Available: The restrooms used by the children in care had hand sanitizers in them.  There was no hand soap. This was corrected at the inspection when the soap dispensers were placed in the restrooms.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Hand Sanitizer - Not Used on Visibly Soiled Hands Unless Away From Classroom and Soap & Water Not Available (26 TAC §746.3420(2))

occurrences.finding: Handwashing Sink in Diaper-Changing Area: A caregiver was changing diapers on a diaper changing table in the pre-k classroom.  There was no hand washing sink in this classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Handwashing Sink in Diaper-Changing Area (26 TAC §746.4403(a))

occurrences.finding: Employee Handwashing After Diapering a Child: A caregiver did not wash her hands after changing a child's diaper.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Employee Handwashing After Diapering a Child (26 TAC §746.3415(4))

occurrences.finding: No Blocked or Locked Doors as Exits: A table and flag blocked the exit in the pre-k classroom.  This was corrected at the inspection when the table and flag were removed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: No Blocked or Locked Doors as Exits (26 TAC §746.5209(c))

occurrences.finding: Active Play Surfacing In Use Zones - Loose Fill or Unitary Surfacing: There was no surfacing under the play equipment on the side playground. The turf grass did not have unitary surfacing under it; it felt hard when walked on.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Active Play Surfacing In Use Zones - Loose Fill or Unitary Surfacing (26 TAC §746.4901(a))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: In several areas throughout the facility, caregivers had their purses low and accessible to children.  NOTE: Corrected during the inspection when the purses were placed out of reach of the children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: There were 11 infants to 2 caregivers in the infant classroom.      This was correctged when 2 infants were moved to another classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training Area - 24 Hours Required: Two of the six employee files reviewed did not have the required 24 hours of annual training hours complete.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training Area - 24 Hours Required (26 TAC §746.1309(a))

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months: The most recent fire inspection report expired on 10/28/21.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Health Statement: Three of the six children's records reviewed did not have a health statement from a physician.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Health Statement (26 TAC §746.603(a)(3))
